

== Build notes: game overview and online play ==

Expanded the game overview with original publisher artwork, credited creators and documented publication history, and added the direct TCGMix destination with its verified preserved copy. Existing article material was retained. Original publication and subsequent online implementations are treated separately.

11 December 1997 is a secondary-reported North American launch day. Use December until a contemporary release record is read. Crusade is documented in 2000. The publisher discontinuation notice is reported as preserved at https://web.archive.org/web/20010607072001/http://www.eternity.com/b5ccg/index.html and the 2001 endpoint requires opening that capture before claiming an exact cancellation month.
